resources.name: Omron Management
resources.description: Backend API for the Omron weight control system. See backend/AGENTS.md for the architecture and docs/schema.dbml for the data model.

resources.name: Auth
resources.description: Sanctum-based auth. login/forgot-password/reset-password are public; me/logout/logout-all require `Authorization: Bearer {{ token }}`. After login, copy `data.access_token` into the `token` env var. Forgot-password always returns 202 (no email leak); the reset link is written to storage/logs/laravel.log because MAIL_MAILER=log in dev.

resources.name: Login
resources.description: POST /api/auth/login — public. Body: email (string, required), password (string, required), device_name (string, optional, default 'api'). Returns 200 with {access_token, token_type: 'Bearer', token_id, name, abilities, expires_at} on success; 401 with generic 'Invalid credentials.' on bad email/password (no email-enumeration leak). After login, copy data.access_token into the `token` env var.

resources.name: Me
resources.description: GET /api/auth/me — auth:sanctum. Returns the authenticated user with eager-loaded roles and profile (same shape as UserResource). 401 if no/invalid token.

resources.name: Logout
resources.description: POST /api/auth/logout — auth:sanctum. Revokes ONLY the current access token (other devices stay logged in). The token used for this call is invalid immediately after.

resources.name: Logout All Devices
resources.description: POST /api/auth/logout-all — auth:sanctum. Revokes ALL access tokens for the authenticated user across every device. Response includes `tokens_revoked` count.

resources.name: Forgot Password
resources.description: POST /api/auth/forgot-password — public. Body: email (string, required). Always returns 202 with a generic 'If that email is registered, a reset link has been sent.' (no enumeration leak). With MAIL_MAILER=log, the reset link is written to storage/logs/laravel.log; grep for '/api/auth/reset-password?token=' to extract the plain-text token.

resources.name: Reset Password
resources.description: POST /api/auth/reset-password — public. Body: email (required), token (required, from the reset link), password (required, min 8, must be confirmed with password_confirmation). 200 on success; 422 with errors.token if the token is invalid/expired or already used. The token in password_reset_tokens table is the bcrypt HASH; the plain-text token is only in the email/log.
